translations.web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
translations.bsb: She rises while it is still night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidservants.
translations.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
translations.asv: She riseth also while it is yet night, And giveth food to her household, And their task to her maidens.
